EndCase

Sub 'PrintData'

For each trnsrefeicaotipo order refTipCodigo when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (refTipCodigo) when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True order refTipAbreviatura when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (refTipAbreviatura) when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True order refTipDescricao when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (refTipDescricao) when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True order refTipperiodo when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (refTipperiodo) when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True order refTipHorario when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (refTipHorario) when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True order refTipHorario2 when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (refTipHorario2) when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True order refTipstatus when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (refTipstatus) when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
using trnsrefeicaotipoWWDS(&DynamicFiltersSelector1, &DynamicFiltersOperator1, &refTipCodigo1, &refTipDescricao1, &refTipperiodo1, &refTipstatus1 , &DynamicFiltersEnabled2, &DynamicFiltersSelector2, &DynamicFiltersOperator2, &refTipCodigo2, &refTipDescricao2, &refTipperiodo2 , &refTipstatus2, &DynamicFiltersEnabled3, &DynamicFiltersSelector3, &DynamicFiltersOperator3, &refTipCodigo3, &refTipDescricao3 , &refTipperiodo3, &refTipstatus3, &TFrefTipCodigo, &TFrefTipCodigo_To, &TFrefTipAbreviatura, &TFrefTipAbreviatura_Sel , &TFrefTipDescricao, &TFrefTipDescricao_Sel, &TFrefTipperiodo_Sels, &TFrefTipHorario, &TFrefTipHorario_To, &TFrefTipHorario2 , &TFrefTipHorario2_To, &TFrefTipstatus_Sels) Where prefCodigo = &prefCodigo &refTipperiodoDescription = '' Do Case Case refTipperiodo.ToString().Trim() = !"M" &refTipperiodoDescription = "Manhã"
Case refTipperiodo.ToString().Trim() = !"T" &refTipperiodoDescription = "Tarde"
Case refTipperiodo.ToString().Trim() = !"N" &refTipperiodoDescription = "Noturno"
Case refTipperiodo.ToString().Trim() = !"I" &refTipperiodoDescription = "Integral"
Case refTipperiodo.ToString().Trim() = !"P" &refTipperiodoDescription = "Parcial"
EndCase &refTipstatusDescription = '' Do Case Case refTipstatus.ToString().Trim() = !"I" &refTipstatusDescription = "Inativo"
Case refTipstatus.ToString().Trim() = !"A" &refTipstatusDescription = "Ativo"
EndCase
